purpose: Replace the empirically transported donor-rank field with one query-aligned joint spatial score model while retaining the sealed V63 bounded conditional marginal as an invertible tail-aware coordinate system. The model learns only from immutable TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift train density fields and uses no pair loss.

historical_V7_failure_control.frozen_observation: V7 optimized a four-condition, two-scale, 3.60-million-parameter density-residual EDM epsilon loss. Its selected model passed TNG but produced a locked-SIMBA k=6-10 h/Mpc power ratio of 1.8401 even though its SIMBA denoising loss improved.
historical_V7_failure_control.design_constraint: V70 may not train directly on the V7 high-pass or Laplacian density residual, may not select by denoising validation loss, and must prove multiscale joint-field behavior with train-only spectral and phase-sensitive proper scores before development access.

latent_representation.condition: the unchanged seven standardized target-free V63 channels: log1p count, radial velocity, intrinsic velocity dispersion, corrected backbone, observer radius, train-only block risk, and train-only object amplitude
latent_representation.physical_target_coordinate: the unchanged V63 standardized full-band residual y=(truth-backbone-target_mean)/target_std on the frozen open bounded support
latent_representation.frozen_local_parameters: the sealed V63 step-12000 EMA bounded five-component mixture evaluated in inference mode with no gradient and never updated by V70
latent_representation.joint_latent: z=Phi_inverse(clamp(u)); train-cache construction uses float64 scipy.special.ndtri on CPU because the installed Lageunha CUDA runtime cannot compile torch erfinv or ndtri, while sampling uses the already audited CUDA-portable standard-normal CDF
latent_representation.physical_inverse: y=bounded_mixture_inverse(V63_parameters,Phi(z)), followed by the unchanged target standardization inverse and one exact full-band residual DC projection before adding the unchanged query backbone
latent_representation.interpretation: V63 supplies a bounded tail-aware invertible local coordinate system; V70 learns the query-conditioned joint distribution of the complete latent cube, including any train-supported residual marginal correction, without donor ranks.

immutable_train_partition.mechanism_holdout: the exact sixteen immutable V65 train query indices per domain; these objects are excluded from V70 optimizer batches and used only after the fixed fit

latent_cache.scope: all 1043 immutable train objects, including a separately marked mechanism-holdout group; no validation or development truth
latent_cache.content: float32 z cube, per-object rank-clamp count, source index, and exact source-data/cache/checkpoint/program provenance
latent_cache.construction: V63 parameters and bounded CDF on the Ada GPU in no-grad inference, transfer u to CPU, float64 scipy.special.ndtri after the frozen clamp, then atomic HDF5 write

joint_spatial_model.family: query-aligned conditional EDM denoiser in the complete 64^3 Gaussianized latent field
joint_spatial_model.input: one noisy latent channel concatenated with all seven V63 condition channels
joint_spatial_model.architecture: reflection-padded three-downsample 3-D residual U-Net with base width 32, two residual blocks per resolution, Fourier noise embedding width 128, skip connections, and one four-head self-attention block only at the 8^3 bottleneck
joint_spatial_model.receptive_field: the three-scale encoder-decoder and bottleneck attention expose every output voxel to cube-wide train-supported context

hard_preflight.fixed_real_batch: train objects 0,1,2,3 from each domain for representation checks; object zero from each domain with signed cube isometry 7 for the model forward/backward check
checks: all frozen hashes, V69 conclusion, V63 fit ancestry, clean worktree, and independent-gate firewalls

the fixed representation batch has per-domain rank-clamp fraction at most 1e-5, absolute latent mean at most 0.1, latent standard deviation in [0.9,1.1], and normal-CDF roundtrip maximum error at most 2e-7
the frozen V63 model is inference-only and receives no gradient

the exact V70 architecture and source hash are recorded, every output and gradient is finite and nonzero on the fixed source-balanced 64^3 batch, and permuting the seven conditions changes the fixed network response
the EDM loss is finite under both full precision and AMP with relative difference at most 0.02 using identical frozen noise
peak allocated Ada memory is strictly below 28 GiB
no optimizer step, latent-cache write, validation, development, Astrid, historical EAGLE, or independent EAGLE access
hard_preflight.failure_action: stop before latent-cache construction or training and preserve the failed hard preflight without changing this program

fixed_training.authorization: only a passed hash-bound hard preflight and passed complete latent-cache scan authorize training
fixed_training.batch: one independently selected fit object from each domain per optimizer update
fixed_training.augmentation: one independently uniform signed cube isometry from the frozen 48-element group per domain object, applied jointly to z and all condition channels
fixed_training.objective: source-balanced arithmetic mean of the standard preconditioned EDM denoising squared error in z; no auxiliary one-point, pair, 2PCF, Fourier, morphology, validation, or development loss
fixed_training.optimizer: AdamW learning rate 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4, cosine schedule to 1e-5, gradient-norm clip 1.0, AMP, and EMA 0.9995
fixed_training.training_diagnostics: loss and numerical diagnostics may be recorded but cannot stop training or select a checkpoint
fixed_training.resume: only exact deterministic recovery from the last atomic checkpoint with RNG and optimizer state; no changed seed, budget, schedule, or checkpoint selection

fixed_sampling.method: deterministic EDM probability-flow Heun sampler from independent standard-normal latent cubes
fixed_sampling.posthoc_global_scale_DC_or_Ak: forbidden except the one predeclared exact residual DC projection inherited from V63

train_only_mechanism_gate.population: the sealed sixteen V65 train query indices per domain that are excluded from V70 optimizer batches
train_only_mechanism_gate.baseline: independent standard-normal voxel ranks passed through the same frozen V63 local inverse and exact DC projection; this preserves the local V63 marginals but contains no learned joint spatial structure
train_only_mechanism_gate.candidate: the fixed step-30000 V70 EMA sampled with the two predeclared independent sixteen-member noise streams
one_point_requirements: per-domain generated latent mean differs from held-out truth by at most 0.1
per-domain generated latent standard deviation divided by held-out truth lies in [0.9,1.1]
per-domain q99.9-backbone physical mean-delta-squared predicted-over-truth lies in [2/3,1.5]
train_only_mechanism_gate.spectral_requirements: for every domain and both independent streams, physical total-power predicted-over-truth is in [0.8,1.25] separately at 3-6 and 6-10 h/Mpc
train_only_mechanism_gate.phase_sensitive_proper_score: a Fourier energy score is computed from the complex residual Fourier coefficients, preserving amplitude and phase, separately in the 3-6 and 6-10 h/Mpc bands; the candidate must be lower than the local-marginal independent-voxel baseline in both bands for every domain
train_only_mechanism_gate.stream_reproducibility: the two candidate streams' domain-and-band Fourier energy scores and total-power log ratios differ by at most ln(1.15)
train_only_mechanism_gate.selection: all one-point, spectral, phase-sensitive proper-score, stream-reproducibility, ancestry, numerical, memory, and firewall requirements pass in all three domains
train_only_mechanism_gate.forbidden: no pair loss, empirical donor rank, 2PCF, validation, development, or independent data may modify the model or these thresholds

fixed_branches.condition: hard preflight or complete latent-cache scan fails
fixed training completes but any train-only mechanism requirement fails
the single locked development gate passes

firewall.independent_EAGLE_access: forbidden without explicit user approval after a locked development pass
